title: Shines
tagline: AI marketing agent with verified influencer data, connecting projects to real users.
description: Our project is an AI-powered marketing agent that helps Web3 teams launch effective campaigns without needing a marketing team. The agent analyzes the project, generates a tailored strategy, and recommends the best influencers through our verified on-chain data layer. Each influencer and user is validated through vLayer proofs to ensure real influence and real engagement. The system then produces a campaign link that influencers share with their communities. Users can apply and verify easily, enabling projects to acquire real audiences and avoid fake metrics, unreliable pricing, and bot activity.
how_its_made:
We built the system around an AI agent that reads project websites and generates customized marketing strategies. The backend uses a database of influencers whose performance metrics are verified with vLayer to create zk-based proof of authenticity and audience reach. Verification proofs are anchored on Celo for speed and low cost.
The interface is a lightweight chatbot that collects project goals, suggests marketing approaches, and generates a shareable campaign link for influencers. When users apply, the flow triggers vLayer verification before accepting them.
The architecture is intentionally minimal for hackathon efficiency: streamlined UI, on-chain verification, influencer data as a trust layer, and automated AI-generated strategy and execution.
